texts:
Open the Agent Spotlight, type the job you need done, and the agent that does it is standing there in 3D with a write-up of what it is for: three.ws/spotlight

The agents index lists thousands of rows. The Agent Spotlight is the other thing: 15 agents so far, each one a pitch attached to a live agent, never a copy of it. Rename the agent or swap its avatar and the card updates with it.

Search reads the headline, the one-liner, the write-up and the agent's own description, so a plain word finds the agent built for it.

The write-ups we wrote ourselves carry a Curated badge, so a visitor is never told a builder said something they did not write. The builder's own write-up replaces ours the moment they submit one.

One upvote per account per entry, and trending decays by the day, so a new entry is seen before it is buried under what was already popular.

Open any one of them, talk to it, fork it, or put your own in front of everybody. Showcase your agent takes a public agent you own, a headline and a one-liner, and the entry is live on its own page with the agent in 3D.

issues.quote: Open the Agent Spotlight, type the job you need done, and the agent that does it is standing there in 3D
issues.problem: With 15 entries, a reader could read this as a promise that any job they type finds a matching agent. The verified facts support search reading the headline, one-liner, write-up and description, not guaranteed coverage. It is a small overhang, not a false statement, and the next paragraph's "a plain word finds the agent built for it" is the mechanism framing that keeps it honest.
issues.fix: Optional polish: change the first line to "Open the Agent Spotlight and type the job you need done. Search reads the write-ups, so a plain word finds the agent built for it: three.ws/spotlight". Ship as is if you prefer the current rhythm.
